title: Arrow structural validation and exact nested IPC boundary
question: Does installed Arrow26 structural validation enforce non-nullability/domain field metadata, and can selected IPC values preserve exact metadata and text?
method: Construct invalid required-field/range examples under explicit Arrow schemas, run full batch validation, then round-trip NUL text and negative zero through zstd IPC while comparing schema metadata. This is a bounded library observation, not product qualification.

results.name: nonnullable null accepted by full validation

conclusion: Installed Arrow26 accepted nulls despite nonnullable field declarations and did not enforce a confidence bound stored only in metadata. The selected zstd IPC roundtrip preserved schema metadata, NUL text and negative zero. These observations require an explicit domain-validation boundary; they are not a general fidelity, performance or production-validation result.
